One country by dataset and variable

Source: R/countries.R
soil_country.Rd

The inventory of one country (GET /countries/{code}): its totals, the totals per dataset and per (dataset, variable). Same assignment rule as soil_countries() (intersects).

Usage

soil_country(soil = soil_session(), code)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted (the code may then be given first: soil_country("KEN")). Client-side: not sent to the API.

code

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code ("KE", "KEN"), any case. API path parameter {code} of GET /countries/{code}.

Value

A list: country (one-row data frame: iso_a2, iso_a3, name, the counts of soil_countries(), source_signature, aggregation_version, refresh_job_id, refreshed_at), datasets (data frame per dataset: provider_code, dataset_code, dataset_name, the API ids country_id, dataset_id, the counts, refreshed_at, ...), variables (data frame per dataset and variable: provider_code, dataset_code, variable_code, original_observation_count, value_count, observation_count), as_of (POSIXct) and country_assignment. An unknown code raises soilhub_not_found_error.

Details

Rights: soil:summary.

See also

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_citations(), soil_code_list(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
kenya <- soil_country(soil, "KEN")
kenya$datasets[, c("dataset_code", "profile_count", "observation_count")]
} # }
